editorial.name: Epidemic Sound
editorial.descriptionZh: 配乐与音效库，按情绪、主题、流派找曲，并配一套给视频配乐的辅助工具：Studio、按画面帧找曲、按一段 riff 找同款、AI 配音。
editorial.takeawayZh: 按画面帧找配乐，下载可商用曲目与音效
editorial.noteZh: 进站先被一整块 We use cookies 弹窗挡住，文案里单独解释了 Change cookie settings 与 Accept。关掉后能看到主标 You bring the idea. We bring the sound.，下挂三条 World-class tracks to move your audience / Soundtracking tools that keep you in flow / Global, worry-free licensing。再往下是客户案例墙，New Balance、GoPro、Squarespace、Nissan、Levi's 各配一首具体曲名与作者（如 Glory Bound by Roy Williams）。工具区里 Studio 主打把音乐和音效按视频节奏对齐，SEARCH BY VIDEO 用画面帧推荐曲目，FIND SIMILAR 用一段 hook 找同调曲，另注明插件已进 Adobe 与 DaVinci Resolve Studio。

reasons.statement: 站点主体是可按 Genres / Themes / Moods / Sound Effects 检索的曲库与音效库，用户拿走的是音频素材。
首页同时推销 Studio、Assistant、Voiceovers、Adapt 等工具，但它们服务于取用音频这一主产物，故主类仍是音频素材。

pages.title: Bring your story to life | Music & SFX for videos | Epidemic Sound
pages.selectionRationale: 本条目采集于 2026-09-15 的首屏实测；手记描述的就是这一屏。

shot.alt: Epidemic Sound 首屏：You bring the idea. We bring the sound.

facts.value: 曲库按 Genres、Themes、Moods、Sound Effects 四轴组织，主题含 Ads, Promos & Trailers、Vlogs、Cinematic、Travel、Corporate、Workout & Wellness、Sports & Action、Nature
facts.evidence: 页面 GENRES, THEMES, MOODS, AND SOUND EFFECTS 区块及其下的主题标签，与 /music/themes/ads-promos-trailers、/music/themes/vlogs 等路径。

facts.value: SEARCH BY VIDEO 用视频里的画面帧给配乐建议，FIND SIMILAR 用一段 riff、hook、drop 或 bridge 找同调曲，Studio 同步人做音乐与音效到视频
facts.evidence: 正文 SEARCH BY VIDEO Let your video do the work. Get track suggestions based on frames within your content. 与 FIND SIMILAR Use music to find music. Search for tracks with a similar tone and sound, using your favorite riff, hook, drop, or bridge.。

facts.value: Voiceovers 提供 70+ 语言的 AI 配音
facts.evidence: 顶部导航项 Voiceovers AI voiceovers, 70+ languages。

facts.value: 需注册免费账号，No credit card required；具体价格未在首页给出，另有 /pricing 与 /our-plans/business-plan
facts.evidence: 首屏 Create free account 按钮与 Contact sales，下方小字 No credit card required；导航有 Pricing，站内存在 /pricing 路径。

facts.value: 配乐工具以插件形式进 Adobe 与 DaVinci Resolve Studio，另有 macOS、Windows、iOS、Android app
facts.evidence: 正文 Soundtrack where you are. The Epidemic Sound plugin is now on Adobe and DaVinci Resolve Studio，导航与站内路径含 /app/macos、/app/windows、/app/ios、/app/android。

cautions: 站点上未找到明确的许可声明，本条记录按 v3 规格记为 unknown；再分发或商用前必须自行确认。
存在付费层：Free account, plans unknown。
